module.purpose: Defines shared TypeScript data contracts for processing newly created bookings, including invitees, payment credentials, users, calendar selections, and attribution tracking.
module.summary: This type-only module centralizes the structures consumed by the new-booking flow. It combines Prisma-derived user data with booking-specific calendar, credential, payment, localization, and marketing attribution fields, while preserving optionality for incomplete invitee contact data and organization metadata.
module.businessContext: Supports scheduling and booking creation across users, calendars, payments, and localized invitee communication. Incorrect types can disrupt booking fulfillment, payment handling, calendar routing, or attribution reporting.
classes: IEventTypePaymentCredentialType (~L26-33): Represents payment application credentials attached to an event type
Invitee (~L13-24): Represents localized contact and scheduling information for booking invitees
IsFixedAwareUser (~L35-43): Represents a user enriched with routing and calendar metadata
Tracking (~L47-53): Represents optional marketing attribution parameters associated with bookings
User (~L11): Derives a Prisma user payload without selected calendar data
systemCapabilities: Enrich users with calendar routing data

contractsProvided.name: Invitee
contractsProvided.shape: export type Invitee = { email: string; name: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; timeZone: string; phoneNumber?: string; language: { translate: TFunction; locale: string; }; }[];

contractsProvided.name: IEventTypePaymentCredentialType
contractsProvided.shape: export interface IEventTypePaymentCredentialType { appId: EventTypeAppsList; app: { categories: App["categories"]; dirName: string; }; key: Prisma.JsonValue; }

contractsProvided.name: IsFixedAwareUser
contractsProvided.shape: export type IsFixedAwareUser = User & { isFixed: boolean; credentials: CredentialForCalendarService[]; organization?: { slug: string }; priority?: number; weight?: number; userLevelSelectedCalendars: SelectedCalendar[]; allSelectedCalendars: SelectedCalendar[]; };

contractsProvided.name: Tracking
contractsProvided.shape: export type Tracking = { utm_source?: string; utm_medium?: string; utm_campaign?: string; utm_term?: string; utm_content?: string; };

invariants.description: Invitees always provide email, name, first and last names, timezone, and localization data.
Payment credentials contain an event application identifier, application metadata, and a JSON key.
Fixed-aware users always include credentials and both user-level and complete selected calendar collections.
